facts: The July 2026 challenge page presents five unknown messages with unusual operators, remarks, and low frequencies.
The 16 September 2026 unbroken list names only BYQMZ, FKQLZ, and XFEDT for Batch C.
A 2026 archival counterpart enabled the ALQFI break and supplies authentic raw 1941 plaintext conventions.
inferences: The ugn recipient-to-sender transition and repeated frequencies support treating the five forms as one traffic-analysis cluster.
The omission of QTXMA and SZAEJ from the later unbroken list is a status discrepancy, not proof that either was solved.
speculation: The challenge page suggests a possible Ordnungspolizei network but states that no confirming evidence was available.
